description: Calculate live astronomical transits, planetary degree alignments, and active elements for any coordinates under the vault. Optional `_meta.apiKey` (your alchm.kitchen API key) and `_meta.caller` (your client identifier, e.g. 'claude-desktop') unlock per-user quotas and invocation telemetry.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of target location (default NYC: 40.7498)

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of target location (default NYC: -73.7976)

name: get_live_sky_transits
